experiment: Latent Topology Discovery + Calibrated Topology Economics
bounded_claims_supported: Under the tested bounded distribution, Creator-0 infers topology-relevant causal/epistemic structure from raw task semantics (critical-distinction recall 0.975, 0 spurious), abduces applicable principles from promoted theta-v1 (top-2 rate 0.95, expected-set recall 1.0), generates and formally validates competing candidate topologies, and selects before execution a topology whose causal shape matches the hidden need in 15/20 trials exactly and 5/20 partially (correctness 0.875).

Every one of 79 realized sessions was fresh (sanitized environment, stream-confirmed identity); zero hidden children; zero historical mutations; predictions hash-frozen before execution; selection strictly preceded realization.
claims_refuted_or_unmet: H3 calibration: utility MAE 0.484 > 0.25 (delta_e over-optimism for over-structured selections; redundancy underestimated).
H4 regret: mean 0.242 > 0.15 (median 0.0; concentrated in COUNTEREXAMPLE trials where a cheaper independent examiner beat the selected isolated child, and in two failed executions).

H5 execution governance-conformance: 8/20 trials carry formal failures (4 ToolSearch-only tool-envelope flags; 4 instrumentation nonconformances: invalid ledger labels, missing/nonconforming child ledgers, one mistyped role cascade).
